title: Withdraw raw CDP, ODP, session and realtime request logs
scope: Bounded W07 future-write containment in CDPService, odpLoop, SessionManager, RealtimeSegmentEngine, FeatureVariableManager and CDP/realtime routes: replace raw errors, bodies, subject/destination/feature labels with fixed labels; retain safe numeric diagnostics and HTTP status. Remove ODP HTTP text reads used only for logs, explicitly allowing the actual non-OK status receipt even when that obsolete body read would reject. Preserve ordinary domain payloads, callback/tenant-relay selection, business GraphQL JSON parsing, return/rethrow/fallback behavior and deterministic decisions.
non_goals: No scoring/ledger/auth/consent/ownership/retry or public error-response policy changes; preserve existing asynchronous sequencing except removal of log-only ODP body reads. No new telemetry pipeline, harness, package or runtime infrastructure.

Other route/scheduled/DO logs, aggregate schema/access/retention, D06 consent/history/datasets and full W07/privacy/customer/deployed/SLO/release scope remain open. Current bounded regression does not reclose old broad task contracts.
No external traffic/cloud/deploy/provision/seed/credentials/customer-data/operational scripts, stage/commit/push, destructive cleanup or unrelated edits.

criteria.description: Actual seven scoped modules remove raw errors/body/dynamic labels from log arguments without altering ordinary business payloads, storage effects, return/rethrow/fallback or route outcomes. ODP non-OK event/profile bodies are not read solely for logs; ordinary status receipts persist and rejecting obsolete text no longer suppresses a real non-OK status callback or tenant relay. GraphQL business JSON parsing remains; raw errors serialization does not. Retain numeric HTTP/aggregate diagnostics.

Existing service, route telemetry and consent controls retain prior raw-writer withdrawal, delivery and OFF-only deterministic behavior; five selected actual-workerd entry/queue cases retain log containment and ack/retry behavior. Bounded current regression only, not full prior contracts, native socket transport or external/customer acceptance.

Independent actual frozen source/baseline/assertion/evidence review and exact K1/K2 reruns, with inspected worker application noEmit/scoped diff and relevant identity, confirm the bounded fixes and ODP receipt correction. Separate lead disposition and handoff retain failures and limits.
